Corporate tax reminder: if your financial year ended on 31 January 2026, your return and payment are due by 31 October 2026.

The rule is nine months after your year end, for both filing and payment. Late filing costs AED 500 a month to start, and interest runs on unpaid tax.

Year end on 31 March? You have until 31 December. Unsure of yours? DM us "TAX".

posts.topic: Free zone does not mean zero tax
posts.caption:
"Set up in a free zone and pay no tax." It is one of the most common assumptions, and it is only true in specific cases.

The 0% rate is for qualifying income of a Qualifying Free Zone Person that meets every condition. Miss one and the standard 9% applies above AED 375,000 of profit.

DM us "ZONE TAX" and we will tell you which side of the line you are on.

#UAECorporateTax #UAEeInvoicing #FTA #DubaiSME #UAEBusiness #ConnectIn
posts.alt: Myth versus fact post: free zone does not automatically mean zero tax. The 0% rate applies only to qualifying income when every condition is met; otherwise 9% applies above AED 375,000 of profit.
